denial_letter:
NOTICE OF ADVERSE BENEFIT DETERMINATION

Date of Notice: March 11, 2022
Claim: Screening colonoscopy, February 2022
Reason Code: CO-E2

Your claim has been processed with member cost-sharing applied. The deductible had not been
met at the time of service, and the amount shown is the member's responsibility under
Section 3.1 of your Certificate of Coverage.

You may request an internal appeal within 180 days of this notice.
denial_reason: Your claim has been processed with member cost-sharing applied. The deductible had not been met at the time of service, and the amount shown is the member's responsibility under Section 3.1 of your Certificate of Coverage.

sub_claims.text: The deductible had not been met at the time of service.
sub_claims.rationale: The sub-claim asserts that the deductible had not been met at the time of service, implying that the deductible applies to this specific claim. However, the evidence establishes that the service in question (a screening colonoscopy) is classified as a preventive service under Section 3.7. Section 3.6 explicitly states that for such preventive services, 'No deductible, copayment, or coinsurance applies.' Therefore, the applicability of the deductible is negated by the policy provisions regarding preventive care, contradicting the implication that the unmet status of the general deductible is a valid basis for denial or cost-sharing in this instance.

sub_claims.text: The amount shown is the member's responsibility under Section 3.1 of your Certificate of Coverage.
sub_claims.rationale: The insurer cites Section 3.1 to assert that the member is responsible for the amount (implying the deductible applies). However, Section 3.1 explicitly states: 'Except as otherwise provided in this Certificate, no benefits are payable until the member has satisfied the annual deductible'. This creates a carve-back for other provisions. Section 3.7 identifies screening colonoscopies for members aged forty-five and older as preventive services for purposes of Section 3.6. Section 3.6 states: 'No deductible, copayment, or coinsurance applies to such services.' Because the service falls under the exception defined in Sections 3.6 and 3.7, the deductible in Section 3.1 does not apply, contradicting the insurer's claim that the member is responsible for the amount under Section 3.1.
